scope: Independent read-only audit of retained fifth engineering pilot, frozen staged source, execution receipts and delivered bytes. No model/provider calls, new R executions, runtime edits or evaluator edits.
overall_assessment: Engineering workflow completion and provenance confirmed; requested figure completeness failed. This is not an all-deliverables scientific validation pass or benchmark-performance estimate.

source_receipts.provider_truncation_qualified: Local character cap; provider extraction can omit pages, equations, figures or tables.

source_version_qualification.interpretation: Receipt is valid official provider-extracted document text, not proof of an exact installed-version documentation snapshot or complete extraction.

blind_handoff.precheck_method: Recomputes inversion and achieved/preceding powers with stats::power.t.test(strict=TRUE), including rounding, from supplied design inputs. It does not hardcode the selected n.
blind_handoff.shared_dependency: Same R stats power.t.test implementation as author; same Haiku model. Fresh/blind context does not establish independent model or package errors.
blind_handoff.proof_limit: Trace verifies ordering and executed blind phase; message withholding is also supported by frozen harness construction. Raw model request messages are represented by digests, not exported plaintext, so this audit is not separate cryptographic absence proof.

numerical_evidence.reference_scope: Two-sided, equal-allocation, fixed two-independent-normal-group pooled-t sample-size inversion with a common SD and no attrition inflation. Checks the declared plan, not source-input validity or other methods.
numerical_evidence.review_post_reveal_qualification: e9 assigns earlier reported candidate/precheck values and computes differences. It does not reread the CSV or plot; its literal artifact-success row is not independent file or scientific validation.

material_scientific_deliverable_issue.audit_conclusion: Artifact production/hash checks pass, but the assertion that PNG/PDF visualize all exact requested CSV rows is unsupported and contradicted by code, warning and PNG pixels.

fair_limitations: Five preparation pilots and generic interface changes preceded this success. It is an exposed familiar task, not a held-out or randomized estimate of accuracy, robustness or multi-agent superiority.

Pilot product capacity is26calls/12R with required review; default single product capacity is18/8. Comparative conclusions require explicit matched global and phase profiles in both modes, as prospectively planned.
Configured phase quotas are ceilings under global limits and future minimum reservations. Actual solver used all5R slots and reviewer all3R slots; unused planned repair capacity was not exercised.
Three real R failures and two author submission rejections remain in the completed trace. Success does not mean every attempted script or interface submission conformed.
Only direct official-source reading was exercised (two callbacks, one cache hit); no search_sources call occurred in this pilot.
Source URL/hash linkage and provider text do not automatically verify every citation interpretation or full document coverage.
The current narrow deterministic pooled-t guard checks declared numerical design; it does not certify source inputs, arbitrary complex methods or figures.
Blind precheck is a separate model conversation with actual R execution; same-model and same-package dependencies remain. After reveal, model-authored pass assertions can still miss actual errors.
Restricted Linux worker is reported and constructed in staged source; this audit did not repeat an adversarial OS-isolation test.
A valid file, digest, signature or model review alone is not scientific visualization validation.
